Union Bankshares New (UBSH) Valuation Rose While Jacobs Levy Equity Management Has Cut by $524,916 Its Stake; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Beacon Financial Group Increased Holding
June 2, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Jacobs Levy Equity Management Inc decreased its stake in Union Bankshares Corp New (UBSH) by 37.34% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jacobs Levy Equity Management Inc sold 14,581 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.44% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 24,470 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $898,000, down from 39,051 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jacobs Levy Equity Management Inc who had been investing in Union Bankshares Corp New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.73B market cap company. The stock increased 0.83% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $41.44. About 254,642 shares traded. Union Bankshares Corporation (NASDAQ:UBSH) has risen 21.26% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.69% the S&P500.
Beacon Financial Group increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 62.87% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beacon Financial Group bought 20,254 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 52,472 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.80 million, up from 32,218 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beacon Financial Group who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $935.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.80% or $3.37 during the last trading session, reaching $190.24. About 21.25 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
